data.name: ExitsHowToCheck
data.value: Not checked against your list yet. Screenshot the game's extract list (raid start, or O twice) to check.
data.comment: Rail, under EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS in a raid, before the extract list was read. 'O twice' is the game's key for the extract list.

data.name: ExitsNoReader
data.value: Can't read your extract list: Windows has no text recognition language. Add one in Windows Settings → Time & language → Language.
data.comment: Rail, under EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS, when Windows can't recognise text. Name Windows' own settings path as Windows shows it in this language.

data.name: ExitsListRead
data.value: Your list this raid: {listed} of {extracts, plural, one {# extract} other {# extracts}} (screenshot at {time}).
data.comment: Rail, under EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS, once the list was read. {listed}: extracts the list names; {extracts}: the side's extracts on this map; {time}: the screenshot's time, 16:40.

data.name: ExitsRowListed
data.comment: Rail, EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS: an extract's row, after its kind ("PMC extract · on your list"), once the game's extract list was read and names it. Lower case, a fragment.

data.name: ExitsRowUnsure
data.comment: Rail, EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS: an extract's row, after its kind, when the game's list names it with ??:??:?? (maybe closed, or it needs something first). "???" as the game shows it.

data.name: ExitsRowNotListed
data.comment: Rail, EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS: an extract's row, after its kind, when the game's extract list leaves it out.

data.name: ExitsGlanceListed
data.comment: Raid card, under EXIT (the nearest extract): the game's extract list names it.

data.name: ExitsGlanceUnsure
data.comment: Raid card, under EXIT: the game's list names it with ??:??:?? (maybe closed, or it needs something first).

data.name: ExitsGlanceUnchecked
data.value: Nearest · not checked against your list
data.comment: Raid card, under EXIT, before a screenshot showed the game's extract list.

data.name: ExitsGlanceNoReading
data.value: Nearest · check your list in game
data.comment: Raid card, under EXIT, when the list can't be read from screenshots (unticked in settings, or Windows can't recognise text).

data.name: ExitsGlanceListedTip
data.value: On the game's extract list for this raid, read from your screenshot.
data.comment: Tooltip of EXIT in the raid card, for an extract on the game's list.

data.name: ExitsGlanceUnsureTip
data.value: On your list, but the game shows ??:??:??: maybe closed, or needs something first.
data.comment: Tooltip of EXIT in the raid card, for an extract the game's list shows with ??:??:??.

data.name: ExitsGlanceUncheckedTip
data.value: Nearest extract for your side, maybe not open this raid. Screenshot the game's extract list (raid start, or O twice) to check.
data.comment: Tooltip of EXIT in the raid card before the extract list was read. 'O twice' is the game's key for the extract list.

data.name: ExitsGlanceNoReadingTip
data.value: Nearest extract for your side, maybe not open this raid. Check your list in the game.
data.comment: Tooltip of EXIT in the raid card when the list can't be read from screenshots.

data.name: ExitsPlainNote
data.comment: Raid card, the OR row under EXIT (shown in capitals): the nearest extract on the list that takes nothing to leave by.

data.name: ExitsPlainTip
data.value: The nearest extract on your list this raid that takes nothing: no item, money, flare, switch or second player.
data.comment: Tooltip of the OR row under EXIT in the raid card.

data.name: CompleteOne
data.comment: The QUEST COMPLETE cue's eyebrow, one quest handed in to a trader Shturmap can't name. Capitals.

data.name: CompleteOneFrom
data.comment: The QUEST COMPLETE cue's eyebrow, one quest handed in. {trader}: the trader's name in capitals, PRAPOR. Capitals.

data.name: CompleteSeveral
data.comment: The cue's eyebrow when several quests were handed in together. Capitals.

data.name: CompleteSeveralCount
data.comment: The cue's title when several quests were handed in together. {count}: how many, 2 or more.

data.name: CompleteUnlocks
data.comment: The cue's detail line: the quests the completed ones unlock. {quests}: their names as a list ("Setup and Shooter Born in Heaven"; ListLast, ListMore).

data.name: ListSeparator
data.comment: Between the names of a list of names, before its last one ("A, B and C"): the comma and the space after it.

data.name: ListLast
data.comment: A list of names, as the QUEST COMPLETE cue says them: "A, B and C". {list}: the names before the last, with ListSeparator between them; {last}: the last name.

data.name: ListMore
data.comment: A list of names cut short: "A, B, C and 2 more". {list}: the names shown, with ListSeparator between them; {count}: how many more there are.

data.name: AgeSeconds
data.comment: How old the last position is, under a minute: status bar ("Fix 12 s ago") and raid card. {seconds}: whole seconds.

data.name: AgeMinutes
data.comment: How old the last position is, under an hour: "Fix 4 min ago". {minutes}: whole minutes.

data.name: AgeHours
data.comment: How old the last position is, an hour or more: "Fix 2 h ago". {hours}: whole hours.

data.name: FixNoneYet
data.value: No position yet: press {keys} for distances
data.comment: Raid card, the line under the raid line, in a raid without a position. {keys}: the game's screenshot keys as help names them, "PrtSc or Home".

data.name: FixDistancesFrom
data.comment: Raid card, the line under the raid line, once the last position is no longer fresh. {age}: how old it is ("45 s", "9 min"; AgeSeconds, AgeMinutes, AgeHours).

data.name: RaidTimeTip
data.value: Time left: the map's raid length minus the time since the raid's start in the log. Can be off after a reconnect.
data.comment: Tooltip of the raid card's clock (time in the raid and time left).

data.name: RaidTimeScavTip
data.value: Time since you joined, by the log. A Scav joins mid-raid, so the time left isn't known.
data.comment: Tooltip of the raid card's clock in a Scav raid.

data.name: RaidTimeNoLengthTip
data.value: Time since the raid's start, by the log. No raid length for this map, so no time left.
data.comment: Tooltip of the raid card's clock on a map whose raid length tarkov.dev doesn't give.

data.name: RaidTimeScav
data.value: {gone} min in · time left not known
data.comment: The raid's time in words, a Scav raid. {gone}: whole minutes since the raid started.

data.name: RaidTimeNoLength
data.comment: The raid's time in words, on a map without a raid length. {gone}: whole minutes since the raid started.

data.name: RaidTimeLeft
data.comment: The raid's time in words. {gone}: whole minutes since the raid started; {left}: whole minutes left.

data.name: RaidTimeOver
data.value: {gone} min in · past the raid's {length} min
data.comment: The raid's time in words, past the map's raid length. {gone}: whole minutes since the raid started; {length}: the map's raid length in minutes.

data.name: StatusNoPosition
data.comment: Status bar (shown in capitals), in a raid without a position. {keys}: the game's screenshot keys as help names them, "PrtSc or Home".

data.name: MapListOtherMaps
data.comment: The MAP list at the top of the rail: the heading over the maps none of your quests is on. Capitals.

data.name: TraderStripTip
data.value: {trader} · {count, plural, one {# active quest} other {# active quests}} · click to hold
data.comment: Tooltip of a trader's portrait in the strip under the MAP list. A click holds the trader's focus: the rows and the map step the other traders' quests back, the maps count the trader's quests. {trader}: the trader's name as the game data gives it ("Ragman"); {count}: that trader's active quests, 0 or more.

data.name: TraderStripTipHeld
data.value: {trader} · {count, plural, one {# active quest} other {# active quests}} · click to let go
data.comment: The same tooltip while that trader's focus is held (the portrait framed in amber): a click lets the focus go. {trader}, {count}: as in TraderStripTip.

data.name: PlanRowTrader
data.comment: A map's count in Plan's rows and in the MAP list while a trader's portrait is clicked (held): how many of that trader's active quests are on the map ("Ragman 2"), in place of "Complete 5 · progress 1". {trader}: the trader's name as the game data gives it; {count}: 1 or more. Keep it this short.

data.name: TourEyebrow
data.comment: The tour's band, above the chapter's title. {chapter}: the chapter shown, from 1; {count}: how many chapters. Capitals.

data.name: WhatsNewHeading
data.comment: The What's New card's heading over a version's lines. {version}: the version with its release's name, "0.4.0 · PRAETORIAN". Capitals.

data.name: OperationalAsOf
data.comment: The right part of the OPERATIONAL eyebrow on a map's card in Plan: when the daily and weekly tasks were read from a screenshot of the game's Tasks screen (a trader's TASKS tab, which brings one task, doesn't move it; while only those brought tasks there is none; owner, 2026-10-25). {time}: "14:02". Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalAsOfDay
data.comment: As OperationalAsOf, when the tasks were read on an earlier day. {date}: "18 Oct"; {time}: "14:02". Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalCount
data.comment: An operational task's progress in its row's muted line: its objective's count as the screenshot showed it ("4 OF 7 · 8 H LEFT"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalPercent
data.comment: An operational task's progress in its row's muted line when it has no single count: the game's percentage ("57% · 8 H LEFT").

data.name: OperationalAnyMap
data.comment: An operational task's muted line in Plan, first, for a task the game says counts on any location ("ANY MAP · HAND OVER AFTER · 2 D LEFT"; the raid card says ANYWHERE in its distance column instead). Shown in capitals; the ANY MAP heading's words.

data.name: OperationalHandOverAfter
data.comment: An operational task's muted line in Plan, for items found in raid that are handed over to the trader after the raid ("ANY MAP · HAND OVER AFTER · 2 D LEFT"). Shown in capitals; short.

data.name: OperationalHandOverAfterRaid
data.comment: As OperationalHandOverAfter, in the raid card ("HAND OVER AFTER THE RAID", with ANYWHERE in the row's distance column). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalMinutesLeft
data.comment: An operational task's time left in its row's muted line in Plan, under an hour ("4 OF 7 · 25 MIN LEFT"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalHoursLeft
data.comment: An operational task's time left in its row's muted line in Plan, under two days, rounded down ("4 OF 7 · 8 H LEFT"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalDaysLeft
data.comment: An operational task's time left in its row's muted line in Plan, from two days on, rounded down (a weekly: "2 D LEFT"). {count}: the days. Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalReadJustNow
data.comment: An operational task's muted line in Plan in place of its time left, when its countdown couldn't be read for sure: how old the screenshot is, under a minute. Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalReadMinutesAgo
data.comment: As OperationalReadJustNow, under an hour ("READ 25 MIN AGO"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalReadHoursAgo
data.comment: As OperationalReadJustNow, under two days, rounded down ("READ 3 H AGO"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalReadDaysAgo
data.comment: As OperationalReadJustNow, from two days on, rounded down ("READ 3 D AGO"). {count}: the days. Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalEndsIn
data.comment: An operational task's time in the raid card, only when it ends before the raid could, in red ("4 OF 7 · ENDS IN 25 MIN"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalEnded
data.value: {count, plural, one {# ended at {time}. Screenshot your tasks for the new one.} other {# ended, the last at {time}. Screenshot your tasks for the new ones.}}
data.comment: Under the OPERATIONAL eyebrow, muted, when daily or weekly tasks ran out since the last screenshot of the game's Tasks screen: the game gives new ones, which only a new screenshot shows. {count}: how many ended; {time}: when the last did, "22:35".

data.name: OperationalCueEyebrow
data.comment: The eyebrow of the cue for a screenshot of the game's Tasks screen (its OPERATIONAL tab), or of a trader's TASKS tab (owner, 2026-10-25), that brought new daily or weekly tasks, over its title. Capitals.

data.name: OperationalCueEnded
data.comment: In a row of the cue of the daily and weekly tasks read, in place of the task's time left, when the task runs out while the cue is up ("WOODS · ENDED"; the other rows keep the time left as read). Shown in capitals; short.

data.name: OperationalCueTitle
data.value: {count, plural, one {# DAILY OR WEEKLY} other {# DAILIES AND WEEKLIES}}
data.comment: The cue's title when a screenshot of the game's Tasks screen (its OPERATIONAL tab), or of a trader's TASKS tab (owner, 2026-10-25), brought new daily or weekly tasks; under it a row for each task read. {count}: how many tasks it lists, 1 to 5 as a rule. The reading doesn't tell a daily from a weekly, so the words never say which. In the 48 px title type: keep it short. Capitals.

data.name: DeskThousands
data.comment: The stash desk: a value in thousands of roubles, short, in a cell's top right and in the head line's totals ("902k", "4.5k"). {amount}: the thousands, with a tenth under 10. No room: a 1×1 cell is 40 DIP wide.

data.name: DeskMillions
data.comment: The stash desk: a value in millions of roubles, short, in a cell and in the head line ("1.01 M", "12.3 M"). {amount}: the millions, three figures.

data.name: DeskRange
data.comment: The stash desk: a cell that fits several items shows their price range, both under a thousand roubles ("300–850"). {low}, {high}: the least and the most.

data.name: DeskRangeThousands
data.comment: The stash desk: a cell that fits several items shows their price range in thousands ("63–307k", "0.3–294k"). {low}, {high}: the least and the most, in thousands.

data.name: DeskRangeMillions
data.comment: The stash desk: a cell that fits several items shows their price range in millions ("0.45–1.18 M"). {low}, {high}: the least and the most, in millions.

data.name: DeskRoubles
data.comment: The stash desk's head line: a total in roubles ("1.01 M ₽", "1.01 M+ ₽" with a container whose contents are unseen in it). {amount}: the short value (DeskThousands, DeskMillions), with its "+".

data.name: DeskChange
data.comment: The stash desk at 56 DIP cells: the price's change over 48 hours in a cell's bottom left, after an arrow from 10 % ("↓ −10%", "+3%"). {change}: the whole percent with its sign.

data.name: DeskLoadout
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over the slots the player wears and carries (the game's GEAR tab, its left column). Capitals.

data.name: DeskRig
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over the tactical rig and its grid, as the game heads it. Capitals.

data.name: DeskPockets
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over the pockets' four cells, as the game heads them. Capitals.

data.name: DeskSpecialSlots
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over the three special slots (marker, compass), as the game heads them; beside POCKETS on one row. Capitals.

data.name: DeskBackpack
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over the backpack and its grid, as the game heads it. Capitals.

data.name: DeskPouch
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over the secure container and its grid, as the game heads it. Capitals.

data.name: DeskStash
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over the stash's page, as the game heads it. Capitals.

data.name: DeskWindowInLoadout
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over a container's open window, read from the screenshot, whose container is in the loadout ("ZHUK · IN THE LOADOUT"). {title}: the container's name as the game titles the window, in capitals. Capitals.

data.name: DeskWindowInRig
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over a container's open window whose container is in the tactical rig ("WZ · IN THE RIG"). {title}: the window's title, in capitals. Capitals.

data.name: DeskWindowInPockets
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over a container's open window whose container is in the pockets ("WZ · IN THE POCKETS"). {title}: the window's title, in capitals. Capitals.

data.name: DeskWindowInSpecialSlots
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over a container's open window whose container is in the special slots. {title}: the window's title, in capitals. Capitals.

data.name: DeskWindowInBackpack
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over a container's open window whose container is in the backpack ("ZHUK · IN THE BACKPACK"); a line runs from it to the container's cell. {title}: the window's title, in capitals. Capitals.

data.name: DeskWindowInPouch
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over a container's open window whose container is in the secure container ("WZ · IN THE POUCH"). {title}: the window's title, in capitals. Capitals.

data.name: DeskWindowInStash
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over a container's open window whose container is in the stash ("T H I C C · IN THE STASH"). {title}: the window's title, in capitals. Capitals.

data.name: DeskWindowInWindow
data.comment: The stash desk: the head over a container's open window whose container stands in another open window ("WZ · IN ZHUK"). {title}, {container}: the two windows' titles, game names, in capitals. Capitals.

data.name: DeskNotAttached
data.value: {count, plural, =0 {Not attached: no {name} on the page} one {Not attached: {name} ×# on the page} other {Not attached: {name} ×# on the page}}
data.comment: The stash desk, muted under the head of a container's open window that can't be tied to one cell: several containers of its name are on the page, or none. {count}: how many; {name}: the window's title, a game name ("WZ").

data.name: DeskNotAttachedSplit
data.value: {count, plural, one {Not attached: {name} ×# on the page, on you and in the stash; counted in neither} other {Not attached: {name} ×# on the page, on you and in the stash; counted in neither}}
data.comment: The stash desk, muted under the head of a container's open window that can't be tied to one cell, when the containers of its name are some on the player and some in the stash: its items count in neither total of the head line (ON YOU, STASH). {count}: how many containers; {name}: the window's title, a game name ("WZ").

data.name: DeskHeadLine
data.comment: The stash desk's head line, in muted capitals over the page: what the items on the player are worth, what the stash's are worth ("1.01 M ₽", "6.84 M+ ₽"), then how many cells are kept for an active quest (now), a quest the active ones unlock (next) and one further down (later), as the cells' notches say. Capitals.

data.name: DeskNotRead
data.comment: The stash desk: muted, inside the dashed frame that stands in the place of a part of the GEAR tab (TACTICAL RIG, POCKETS, BACKPACK, STASH…) no screenshot has shown yet, so the desk keeps the game's layout; under LOADOUT's head when its slots weren't seen. Capitals; the frame is five cells wide (200 DIP at the smallest), SPECIAL SLOTS' three (120 DIP), where the words wrap.

data.name: DeskHeadSince
data.comment: The stash desk: the head of a part the last screenshot didn't show, drawn a step dimmer: its head and when the screenshot that last showed it was taken ("BACKPACK · 23:08", "KEYS · IN THE STASH · 19 OCT 23:08"). {head}: the part's head (DeskBackpack, DeskWindowInStash…); {time}: "23:08", or on an earlier day the date and time as the language writes them ("19 OCT 23:08"), its spaces no-break. A no-break space after the "·", so a head that wraps (SPECIAL SLOTS, three cells wide) takes the "·" with the time to its next line. Capitals.

data.name: DeskSlotEarpiece
data.comment: The stash desk: a loadout slot as the GEAR tab heads it, the small muted eyebrow over its box on the desk's LOADOUT (a box two cells wide: about 80 DIP at the smallest; a longer name is set smaller, never under 8 px), and on the card over the item's name ("HEADWEAR" over "BAC Bastion"). The game's own word where the game has one. Capitals.

data.name: DeskSlotHeadwear
data.comment: The stash desk: a loadout slot, over its box and on the card (DeskSlotEarpiece).

data.name: DeskSlotFaceCover
data.comment: The stash desk: a loadout slot, over its box and on the card (DeskSlotEarpiece).

data.name: DeskSlotArmband
data.comment: The stash desk: a loadout slot, over its box and on the card (DeskSlotEarpiece).

data.name: DeskSlotBodyArmor
data.comment: The stash desk: a loadout slot, over its box and on the card (DeskSlotEarpiece).

data.name: DeskSlotEyewear
data.comment: The stash desk: a loadout slot, over its box and on the card (DeskSlotEarpiece).

data.name: DeskSlotDogtag
data.comment: The stash desk: a loadout slot, over its box and on the card (DeskSlotEarpiece).

data.name: DeskSlotOnSling
data.comment: The stash desk: a loadout slot, the primary weapon's, over its box five cells wide and on the card (DeskSlotEarpiece).

data.name: DeskSlotHolster
data.comment: The stash desk: a loadout slot, the pistol's, over its box and on the card (DeskSlotEarpiece).

data.name: DeskSlotOnBack
data.comment: The stash desk: a loadout slot, the second long weapon's, over its box five cells wide and on the card (DeskSlotEarpiece).

data.name: DeskSlotSheath
data.comment: The stash desk: a loadout slot, the knife's, over its box and on the card (DeskSlotEarpiece).

data.name: DeskCardOffers
data.comment: The stash desk's card, under the item's name in muted capitals after the liquidity dot: how many offers the flea had at its last scan. {count}: the offers.

data.name: DeskCardFleaLevel
data.comment: The stash desk's card, after the offers (DeskCardOffers), joined by " · ": the player level the flea lists the item from. The player's own level isn't read, so nothing is compared. Capitals.

data.name: DeskCardNotOnFlea
data.comment: The stash desk's card, under the item's name in place of the offers: the item can't be listed on the flea market. Capitals.

data.name: DeskCardRoubles
data.comment: The stash desk's card: a full price in roubles, "970,000 ₽", the gold figure's and the plate's. {amount}: the number with the language's thousands separator. A no-break space before ₽.

data.name: DeskCardSevenDays
data.comment: The stash desk's card, at the right of the gold figure: the change of the item's average flea price over the last 7 days, from its price history ("↑ +1.7% · 7 D"). {change}: the arrow and the change with its sign. Capitals, short.

data.name: DeskCardTwoDays
data.comment: The stash desk's card, at the right of the flea's net line: the change over 48 hours, from tarkov.dev's item file ("↓ −10.3% · 48 H"). {change}: the arrow and the change with its sign. Capitals, short.

data.name: DeskCardFleaNet
data.comment: The stash desk's card, under the plate: what selling the stack on the flea at the last low brings after the flea's fee; DeskCardFee follows it after " · " (the line breaks between them where it wraps). {net}: a full price in roubles (DeskCardRoubles).

data.name: DeskCardNets
data.comment: The stash desk's card, the plate's second line under DeskCardCopies, muted: what one sale at the copied price brings after the flea's fee. {net}: roubles, in thousands from six digits ("873k ₽"), in full under ("10,800 ₽").

data.name: DeskCardFee
data.comment: The stash desk's card, after DeskCardFleaNet and " · ": the flea's fee for that sale. {fee}: a full price in roubles.

data.name: DeskCardWeekMark
data.comment: The stash desk's card, the mark beside the dashed hairline 7 days back in the 30 days' price band: "7 days". Capitals, as short as DeskCardSevenDays' "7 D"; a no-break space.

data.name: DeskRuleLowerTip
data.comment: Tooltip and name of the − button of the stash desk's copy rule (on the card's plate and in settings): what a click on a cell copies after pressing it. {rule}: DeskCopiedUnder, DeskCopiedMatch or DeskCopiedOver ("4% under the last low", "the last low", "1% over the last low"; QA pass of step C, F4: the button over the last low said "further under" where it goes to 1 % over).

data.name: DeskRuleHigherTip
data.comment: As DeskRuleLowerTip, the + button.

data.name: DeskCardCopyHead
data.comment: The stash desk's card: the plate's eyebrow over what a click on the item's cell copies to the clipboard (its flea list price, for the flea's price field); beside it the rule's control, − and + around DeskRuleMatch, DeskRuleUnder or DeskRuleOver. Capitals.

data.name: DeskRuleMatch
data.comment: The stash desk's copy rule, in its control on the card's plate and in settings' row, between − and +: the price a click copies is the flea's last low price, matched. Capitals, short (the control is about 150 DIP).

data.name: DeskRuleUnder
data.comment: The stash desk's copy rule, as DeskRuleMatch: the price a click copies is this much under the flea's last low. {amount}: 1 to 20. Capitals, short.

data.name: DeskRuleOver
data.comment: The stash desk's copy rule, as DeskRuleMatch: the price a click copies is this much over the flea's last low. {amount}: 1 to 20. Capitals, short.

data.name: DeskCardCopies
data.comment: The stash desk's card, on the plate under A CLICK COPIES: the list price a click on the cell copies (per item, as the flea's price field takes it). Short: the plate's line is one line in the rail's 351 DIP (QA pass of step C, F5). {price}: a full price in roubles (DeskCardRoubles; with "~" where it is scaled to a condition).

data.name: DeskCardOverBest
data.value: Over the best net: at {best} it nets {bestNet}, at this {net}
data.comment: The stash desk's card, the plate's second line under DeskCardCopies (which carries the status bar's gold light), muted: the copied price is above the price that nets the most after the flea's fee (the fee grows faster than the price there). {best}, {bestNet}, {net}: roubles, in thousands from six digits.

data.name: DeskCardTraderPaysMore
data.value: {trader} pays more · {price}. A click copies nothing.
data.comment: The stash desk's card, on the plate: at the rule's price the flea nets less after its fee than the best trader pays, so a click on the cell copies nothing. {trader}: the trader's name; {price}: what the trader pays for one (DeskCardRoubles).

data.name: DeskCardNoFlea
data.value: Can't be listed on the flea. A click copies nothing.
data.comment: The stash desk's card, on the plate: the game doesn't let the item be listed on the flea market (tarkov.dev's noFlea), so a click copies nothing; the traders' prices stand below.

data.name: DeskCardNoFleaFir
data.value: The flea takes it found in raid only. A click copies nothing.
data.comment: The stash desk's card, on the plate: the flea wants the item found in raid and the cell's found-in-raid mark wasn't seen, so a click copies nothing.

data.name: DeskCardNoOffers
data.value: No offers on the flea. A click copies nothing.
data.comment: The stash desk's card, on the plate: tarkov.dev saw no flea offer for the item (no last low), so a click copies nothing.

data.name: DeskCardFleaOff
data.value: The flea is off. A click copies nothing.
data.comment: The stash desk's card, on the plate: the flea market is off in the game's settings (tarkov.dev's fleaMarket.enabled), so a click copies nothing.

data.name: DeskCardNoPrice
data.value: No price for this cell. A click copies nothing.
data.comment: The stash desk's card, on the plate: nothing was read of the cell, or the item file has no price for it.

data.name: DeskCardLastLow
data.comment: The stash desk's card, the plate's second line, muted: the flea's last low price per item, which the rule moves. {price}: a full price in roubles.

data.name: DeskCardTraderPays
data.comment: The stash desk's card, the plate's second line after the last low (" · "), muted: what the best trader pays for one. {trader}: the trader's name; {price}: a full price in roubles.

data.name: DeskCardScaled
data.comment: The stash desk's card, under the plate: the figure is scaled to the condition the cell prints ("1469/1800"), and what it is at full condition. {print}: the printed condition as the game prints it; {full}: a full price in roubles.

data.name: DeskCardEstimate
data.value: ~ an estimate: the condition is not printed
data.comment: The stash desk's card, under the plate: the item's condition matters to its price (armour, meds, weapons) but the cell prints none, so the figure is the full condition's, marked "~".

data.name: DeskCardUnseen
data.value: Contents unseen: open it in the game, then a screenshot
data.comment: The stash desk's card, under the plate, for a container whose window no screenshot showed, or a weapon (its mods): its figure ends in "+", at least this, more inside.

data.name: DeskCardKeep
data.comment: The stash desk's card: the heading over what the item is kept for, the quests and hideout modules that need it. Capitals.

data.name: DeskCardKeepQuest
data.comment: The stash desk's card, a KEEP line: a quest that needs the item, how many, and when (DeskCardNow, DeskCardNext, DeskCardLater). {quest}: the quest's name; {count}: how many it wants.

data.name: DeskCardNow
data.comment: The stash desk's card, a KEEP line's when (DeskCardKeepQuest): an active quest needs it.

data.name: DeskCardNext
data.comment: The stash desk's card, a KEEP line's when (DeskCardKeepQuest): a quest the active ones unlock, or one open to start, needs it.

data.name: DeskCardLater
data.comment: The stash desk's card, a KEEP line's when (DeskCardKeepQuest): a quest further down the quest tree needs it.

data.name: DeskCardKeepStation
data.comment: The stash desk's card, a KEEP line: a hideout module's level that takes the item, how many. {station}: the station's name ("Medstation"); {level}: its level; {count}: how many.

data.name: DeskCardFir
data.comment: The stash desk's card: a KEEP line whose need wants the item found in raid. {line}: the line (DeskCardKeepQuest, DeskCardKeepStation). FIR: found in raid, the players' word.

data.name: DeskCardThirtyDays
data.comment: The stash desk's card: the heading over the item's flea price band of the last 30 days. Capitals.

data.name: DeskCardBandNote
data.value: average to lowest offer, every 2 h
data.comment: The stash desk's card, under the 30 days' band, muted: what the band shows, from the average down to the lowest offer, a point every 2 hours.

data.name: DeskCardHighLow
data.value: {days, plural, =0 {HIGH {high} · LOW {low} TODAY} one {HIGH {high} · LOW {low}, # DAY AGO} other {HIGH {high} · LOW {low}, # DAYS AGO}}
data.comment: The stash desk's card, under the 30 days' band, muted capitals: the highest average and the lowest offer of the 30 days, and how long ago the low was. {high}, {low}: short values ("1.05 M"); {days}: whole days.

data.name: DeskCardHistoryLoading
data.comment: The stash desk's card, where the price band will stand while its history is being fetched: a quiet ellipsis.

data.name: DeskCardNoHistory
data.comment: The stash desk's card, under 30 DAYS: the item's price history couldn't be had (offline without a saved copy, or tarkov.dev has none).

data.name: DeskCardDay
data.comment: The stash desk's card: the heading over the day's price range bar. Capitals.

data.name: DeskCardDayMarks
data.comment: The stash desk's card, over the day's range bar, muted capitals: the flea's last low (the amber tick on the bar) and the day's average (the ink tick). {last}, {avg}: full prices.

data.name: DeskCardOutlier
data.value: The high, {high}, is past the bar: one offer, likely an outlier.
data.comment: The stash desk's card, under the day's range bar: the day's highest offer is far above the rest, so the bar isn't drawn to it. {high}: a full price.

data.name: DeskCardTraders
data.comment: The stash desk's card: the heading over what each trader pays for one, the best first. Capitals.

data.name: DeskCardCraftsBarters
data.comment: The stash desk's card: the heading over the hideout crafts and the traders' barters that give the item. Capitals.

data.name: DeskCardAge
data.value: {minutes, plural, =0 {Prices just in · tarkov.dev} one {Prices # min old · tarkov.dev} other {Prices # min old · tarkov.dev}}
data.comment: The stash desk's card, its last line, muted: how old the prices are, from tarkov.dev's last scan of the item (its `updated` time), and where they come from. {minutes}: whole minutes.

data.name: DeskCardAgeHours
data.value: {hours, plural, one {Prices # h old · tarkov.dev} other {Prices # h old · tarkov.dev}}
data.comment: The stash desk's card, its last line, as DeskCardAge, from two hours on. {hours}: whole hours.

data.name: DeskCardOneOf
data.value: {count, plural, one {One of # item} other {One of # items}}
data.comment: The stash desk's card of a cell that fits several items alike (its "?"): the title. {count}: how many it may be.

data.name: DeskCardPickNote
data.value: Pick the one it is: the pick stays for this cell, and a click copies its price.
data.comment: The stash desk's card of a "?" cell, under its title, muted: a click on one of the candidates below picks it for the cell.

data.name: DeskCopied
data.comment: A one-line notice after a click on a stash desk's cell: the list price now on the clipboard, and the rule it was made by (DeskCopiedUnder, DeskCopiedOver, DeskCopiedMatch). {price}: a full price in roubles (DeskCardRoubles).

data.name: DeskCopiedUnder
data.comment: The rule in the notice DeskCopied: the price is this much under the flea's last low. {amount}: 1 to 20.

data.name: DeskCopiedOver
data.comment: The rule in the notice DeskCopied: the price is this much over the flea's last low. {amount}: 1 to 20.

data.name: DeskCopiedMatch
data.comment: The rule in the notice DeskCopied: the price is the flea's last low, matched.

data.name: DeskCopiedScaled
data.comment: The rule in the notice DeskCopied for a price scaled to the condition the cell prints. {rule}: DeskCopiedUnder, DeskCopiedOver or DeskCopiedMatch; {print}: the condition as printed ("1469/1800").

data.name: DeskCopiedOverBest
data.comment: The rule in the notice DeskCopied when the price is above the price that nets the most after the fee (the card's plate says more). {rule}: as in DeskCopiedScaled.

data.name: DeskNothingTrader
data.comment: A one-line notice after a click on a stash desk's cell that copies nothing: the best trader pays more than the flea nets at the rule's price. {trader}: the trader's name; {price}: a full price in roubles.

data.name: DeskNothingNoFlea
data.value: Nothing copied: it can't be listed on the flea
data.comment: A one-line notice after a click on a stash desk's cell that copies nothing: the item can't be listed on the flea (noFlea, not found in raid where the flea wants it, no offers, or the flea is off).

data.name: DeskNothingPick
data.value: {count, plural, one {One of # item: pick it on the card first} other {One of # items: pick it on the card first}}
data.comment: A one-line notice after a click on a stash desk's cell that fits several items alike (its "?"): nothing copied until the player picks which it is on its card. {count}: how many it may be.

data.name: DeskNothingPrice
data.value: Nothing copied: no price for this cell
data.comment: A one-line notice after a click on a stash desk's cell with no price (nothing read, or no such item in the data).

data.name: DeskCopyFailed
data.value: Couldn't copy: the clipboard is busy. Try again.
data.comment: A one-line notice: a click on a stash desk's cell couldn't put its price on the clipboard (another program held it).

data.name: GlanceEyebrow
data.comment: The in-raid glance's plate over the map, its eyebrow over the title: a screenshot taken in a raid showed an inventory screen (the player's own, or a looted container or body). Capitals.

data.name: GlanceLootWord
data.comment: The in-raid glance's plate: the title's word before the total of what the LOOT pane shows ("LOOT 1.87 M+ ₽"), and the head of a container's grid whose kind the game didn't name. "Loot" is the game's pane heading and the players' word. Capitals.

data.name: GlanceOnYouWord
data.comment: The in-raid glance's plate: the title's word before the total of the player's own gear, on a screenshot of the player's inventory alone (no LOOT pane): "ON YOU 1.01 M+ ₽". As the stash desk's head line says it (DeskHeadLine). Capitals.

data.name: GlanceOnYou
data.comment: The in-raid glance's plate, the line under the LOOT total: what the player's own gear is worth. {total}: a total in roubles ("1.01 M+ ₽", the "+" where contents went unseen). As the stash desk's head line says it (DeskHeadLine).

data.name: GlanceUnsure
data.comment: The in-raid glance's plate, muted after the ON YOU line: how many of the loot's cells fit several items alike (their "?" plate, a price range), so the total counts them at their least.

data.name: GlanceNothingLooted
data.value: Your gear · nothing looted on this screen
data.comment: The in-raid glance's plate, the line under "ON YOU 1.01 M+ ₽" when the screenshot showed the player's inventory alone, no LOOT pane: the plate draws no cells then (the player's own gear is known).

data.name: GlanceUnsearched
data.comment: The in-raid glance's plate: a body's part (its rig, pockets or backpack) the game hasn't searched yet, so its contents are unseen; followed by "+". The English game's word on that part. Capitals.

data.name: GlanceSearching
data.comment: The in-raid glance's plate: a body's part the game was searching when the screenshot was taken, so more may be in it; followed by "+". The English game's word. Capitals.

data.name: GlanceMoreBelow
data.comment: The in-raid glance's plate: a looted grid the game's LOOT pane had scrolled past its foot, so more of it is unseen; followed by "+". Capitals.

data.name: GlanceAlso
data.comment: The in-raid glance's plate, the first word of the line that names the looted parts it had no room to draw, each with its total: "ALSO · BACKPACK 412k+ ₽ · POCKETS 23k ₽". Capitals.

data.name: GlanceCutRegion
data.comment: The in-raid glance's plate, one name in the line after ALSO (GlanceAlso): a looted part it had no room to draw and what it holds. {name}: the part's head ("BACKPACK"); {total}: a total in roubles ("412k+ ₽").
